request: Analyze GSE161030 for PMID 33757294 (Antihypertrophic Memory After Regression of Exercise-Induced Physiological Myocardial Hypertrophy Is Mediated by the Long Noncoding RNA Mhrt779.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: rRNA-depleted total RNA-seq ('lncRNA sequencing') of whole mouse heart, Illumina HiSeq 2000; transcript-level quantification (HISAT2 + StringTie)
final.sample_inclusion: 3 EHP hearts (swimming 3 weeks + sedentary 1 week) and 3 sedentary hearts, male C57BL/6, collected 1 week after termination of swimming, before TAC/sham (S2.3.p1; GEO extract_protocol)
final.primary_estimand: Effect of exercise hypertrophic preconditioning (21 days swimming then 1 week detraining) vs sedentary on cardiac transcript (lncRNA) expression
planned_contrasts: EHP vs Sed (S2.3.p1, FIG4; paper: 2162 DE lncRNAs, 1482 up / 680 down)
final.paper_method: DESeq2 (FIG4 legend 'DESeq analysis'; GEO data_processing 'DEseq2'), ~ grp

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S2.3.p1: lncRNA sequencing in 3 EHP and 3 sedentary hearts (GSE161030); 2162 differentially expressed (1482 higher, 680 lower in EHP), |log2 FC| > 1 and P < 0.05. FIG4 legend: DESeq, >=2-fold and P < 0.05. GEO data_processing states a different rule (RPKM > 500, |log2FC| > 1, padj < 0.05) but the paper's count is reproduced exactly from the deposited DESeq2 table with raw P < 0.05 and |log2FC| > 1 (2162/1482), so the paper rule is raw P.

checks: 6 GSMs: sedentary1-3 / EHP1-3 match paper n=3+3
matrix columns Sed1-3/EHP1-3 equal metadata description
authors' deposited DESeq2 table has the same 27884 feature IDs as the counts filtered to row sum >= 10

ownership.reasoning: Paper names the accession; sample groups and n match.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns Sed1..EHP3 equal the metadata description column exactly (6/6). grp derived from the same field; consistent with characteristics treatment (sedentary 4w / swimming 3w +sedentary1w).

matrix.reasoning: All values integer (0-448482, median 5); GEO data_processing 'Supplementary_files_format_and_content: raw counts'; StringTie transcript quantification. Authors' DESeq2 table baseMean values are consistent with these counts.

design.reasoning: Randomized two-arm exercise vs sedentary design, n=3 per arm, all male; single grouping column. Note the exercise arm was measured 1 week after training stopped (detraining memory estimand), as the paper intends.

covariance.reasoning: Independent animals, one per sample; no batch, sex (all male) or lane variable recorded.

deviations: pre-filter genes with row-sum >= 10 (mean >= 10/6) to match the 27884 features in the authors' DESeq2 table; the paper does not state the filter

method.reasoning: Paper and GEO both use DESeq2 on raw counts; the matrix supports it.

threshold.reasoning: S2.3.p1: |log2 FC| > 1 and P < 0.05 (raw P). Audit: BH padj < 0.05 with the same fold change (closer to the GEO data_processing rule, without its RPKM > 500 filter, which cannot be applied: no RPKM deposited).

caveats: Features are StringTie transcripts (transcript:ENSMUST...), not only lncRNAs; the paper's 2162 'lncRNAs' equal the authors' full deposited table at P<0.05 & |log2FC|>1, so all transcripts are counted.
Paper's significance rule uses raw P with n=3 per group; many calls are not FDR-controlled (see audit count).
Mhrt779 is not an Ensembl-annotated transcript ID in this matrix, so the paper's named gene cannot be looked up.

study.reasoning: Paper-aligned reproduction of the single planned contrast.

discrepancies.data: all StringTie transcripts (46746; 27884 with row-sum >= 10 in the authors' table)

executions.name: grp_EHP_vs_Sed
executions.reasoning: Paper's two-group DESeq2; filter row-sum >= 10 to match the authors' deposited feature set.
